messages:
Maya: Quick thought 9 0 run a tiny "early access toolkit" pilot tied to the upcoming workshop. Grant 50 starter tokens + a prompt template pack to first-time attendees who both register and show. Primary KPI: 7-day activation = >=5 API calls or 1 completed chat flow.

Jon: Nice. Need clear arms. Control / email-only / email+in-app nudge? :thinking_face:

Elaine: Routing idea  email for registrants, in-product banner for signed-in RSVPers. For folks who don't have accounts, send a claim link in the welcome flow.

Sam (growth): I can wire cohorts in Amplitude. Randomize at RSVP to avoid selection bias. Will need the event spec and required props.

Maya: Proposed arms:
- A: baseline (no extra outreach)
- B: email-only (subject + claim CTA)
- C: email + in-app banner + auto-insert prompt pack on first session
Window: gift redeemable for 14 days after workshop, measure 7-day and 14-day activation + retention.

Jon: Email subject hypotheses: avoid the word "free". Options: "Your Redwood workshop toolkit" or "Early access: templates + tokens inside". Leaning to the first.

Elaine: I'll draft email copy. Include 1-2 sample prompts so the value is visible immediately. Need banner short + extended copy variants.

Sam (growth): Event list I'm tracking: 
```
- workshop_registered
- workshop_attended
- toolkit_claimed (prop: arm)
- first_api_call (prop: success)
- prompt_template_used (prop: template_id)
- tour_started
- tour_completed
```
Also capture user_cohort (A/B/C) and signup_source.

devex-bot: Dev note: promo tokens are single-use, TTL 14d. Use POST /promo/generate with marketing-scoped key. Landing URL pattern: /workshop/toolkit/claim/<code>. The landing will fire toolkit_claimed with arm + referrer then redirect to quickstart with promptpack preloaded.

Maya: Can we auto-insert a small in-product overlay after claim that highlights 3 exemplar prompts and offers a "run one now" button? Track run_immediate as an event.

Jon: Add telemetry for that overlay: overlay_shown, overlay_action (run_now/copy_prompt). Also QA email + banner Thursday.

Sam (growth): I'll prepare sample size calc and funnel targets. Tentative conversion targets: 20% claim rate on arm C, 8-10% on email-only, baseline ~3-5%. 7-day activation lift target +10pp vs control. Will formalize and post by EOD Friday.

Elaine: Drafts will go into the marketing drive. I'll drop the link here when ready and @legal for quick terms check (mentions tokens & TTL).

Maya: Checklist: 
- Amplitude cohort + event spec (Sam)
- Promo generation + scoped key (devex-bot)
- Landing + redirect + analytics (devex-bot)
- Email + banner copy variants (Elaine)
- Prompt pack content + 3 exemplar prompts (Maya)
- Legal signoff on token language (Elaine/Legal)
- QA plan for email/banner/landing (Jon)

Jon: Also recommend adding a tiny UTM matrix so we can attribute channel-level lifts. utm_medium=workshop, utm_campaign=toolkit_drop, utm_variant=A/B/C.

Sam (growth): Noted. I'll include utm props in the event schema.

Maya: If everyone agrees, let's lock the arms tomorrow and schedule a 20m sync after Elaine posts drafts.

Elaine: Will post drafts Wed 11am PT and tag legal.

Jon: :thumbsup: Good plan.
